def merge_intervals(items):
    if not items:
        return []
    
    # Sort by start time
    sorted_items = sorted(items)
    
    merged = [sorted_items[0]]
    
    for current in sorted_items[1:]:
        prev = merged[-1]
        
        # If current interval overlaps or touches the previous one
        if current[0] <= prev[1]:
            # Merge by updating the end to the maximum of the two ends
            merged[-1][1] = max(prev[1], current[1])
        else:
            # No overlap, add the current interval
            merged.append(current)
    
    return merged
